en.description:
Race across platforms, dodge obstacles, and survive as long as you can in this addictive, fast-paced endless runner—now fully optimized for both iPhone and Apple Watch!

Whether you are looking for an intense gaming session on your phone or a quick burst of action right on your wrist, Chaos Rush delivers hardcore platforming anywhere you go.

TAP TO JUMP
Simple one-touch controls perfect for any screen size. Tap to jump, hold to keep jumping. Easy to learn, but incredibly hard to master!

ENDLESS & LEVEL MODES
Test your reflexes in the classic Endless Runner mode, or take on curated levels packed with boost pads, walls, and teleport portals. Don't forget to check back for the free Level of the Day!

COLLECT POWER-UPS
 • Shield - Block one fatal hit
 • Magnet - Attract nearby coins
 • Grappling Hook - Save yourself from falling into the void
 • Double Jump - Tap again mid-air to cross massive gaps
 • Dash - Double-tap for a horizontal speed burst

PORTALS & TRAPS
Navigate tricky platforms and avoid deadly spikes as the game speeds up. Master dynamic portals to survive:
 • Speed Boost - Blast through at lightning speed
 • Slow Motion - Slow down time to plan your next moves
 • Nuke - Destroy all obstacles on the screen!

COMPETE GLOBALLY
Climb daily and all-time leaderboards. Every curated level has its own leaderboard with rank rewards—top players earn bonus coins. Sign in with Apple to save your progress and compete against players worldwide.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SQUARE
Unlock unique avatars, patterns, and vibrant colors using the coins you earn from your runs.

FREE TO PLAY
Jump in for free every day with 25 daily plays—run Endless Mode, take on the Level of the Day, and tackle a starter set of curated levels. A single, one-time in-app purchase unlocks unlimited plays and our pro level collection across both iPhone and Apple Watch. (No hidden subscriptions!)

UNIVERSAL APP
Play seamlessly on your iPhone, or leave your phone in your pocket and play directly on your Apple Watch. Your coins, unlocks, and leaderboard rank sync across both devices—one game, two screens.
en.releaseNotes:
Chaos Rush is now a universal app — play on iPhone and Apple Watch with a single purchase!

What's new in 2.6:
 • iPhone version with full-screen portrait gameplay
 • Cross-device sync: coins, unlocks, avatars, and leaderboard rank stay in sync across both devices
 • Refreshed sign-in and account experience
 • Bug fixes and performance optimizations

Thanks for playing!
en.subtitle: Jump, Dash & Dodge Traps
